Atkinson Hyperlegible, in this directory
=======================================

    atkinson-400.woff2       atkinson-400-ext.woff2
    atkinson-700.woff2       atkinson-700-ext.woff2

Copyright 2020 Braille Institute of America, Inc.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.

    https://openfontlicense.org
    https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible

⚠️ THE FULL LICENCE TEXT IS NOT COPIED HERE, AND THAT IS A CHOICE THIS FILE HAS
TO DEFEND. The OFL requires that the licence travel with the font, and a link is
not a copy. What is shipped in `dist` is the four `.woff2` files and this note;
what a redistributor needs is the text.

So: THIS IS OWED. `docs/LICENSES.md` records it as owed rather than pretending
otherwise, and the text goes here — verbatim, from openfontlicense.org — before
this game is published anywhere. The note is written now because a licence
obligation that lives only in somebody's memory is the one that gets shipped
without being met.

Where they came from
--------------------

    source        ~/Claude/game-platformer/app/public/vendor/fonts/
    why           the Dev: "Menus devem usar a mesma identidade visual que o
                  game-platformer." That project's own `vendor/fonts.css` calls
                  Atkinson "PADRAO (UI/leitura)" and calls the set "Fontes
                  oficiais do EdSP". A second game in the same catalogue picking
                  its own face is a child meeting a different alphabet in the
                  next room.
    what travels  four faces of one family. The platformer vendors nineteen
                  families because it lets a reader CHOOSE one; this game has no
                  such menu, and a megabyte of fonts nobody can select is a
                  megabyte in the precache budget of a school laptop.

Why this face and not a decorative one
--------------------------------------

The Braille Institute drew Atkinson Hyperlegible to separate the characters low
vision confuses -- I l 1, O 0, b d, and the ones that mirror. This game's screens
argue for every other choice on those grounds; the letters they are written in
are not the place to stop.

⚠️ AND IT REPLACES NOTHING. Press Start 2P is bundled at
`app/assets/fonts/press-start-2p.woff2`, loaded through the FontFace API, and it
is still what the wordmark is set in -- the Dev asked for it by name. This face
is for the text: the table list, the pause menu, the score, the keys. A logo and
a paragraph are different jobs.
